name: Barnabas
description: Levite living at the time of the New Testament

points: When Saul comes to Jerusalem he tries to join the disciples, but they are afraid of him until Barnabas brings him to the apostles and declares how he had seen the Lord and preached boldly at Damascus. Notice Acts does not tell us he went to Arabia first; Paul fills in that detail himself in Galatians.

As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work. When Bishop says separate that brother for the work, he's not talking about Atlanta, Miami, or California. Did Israel only scatter in America? Separate them for the work means no matter where the work is, you got to go there.

note.label: Called to Judge: Commanded to Be Just

points: Paul and Barnabas waxed bold: it was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you, Judah; but seeing ye put it from you, lo, we turn to the Gentiles. Who are these Gentiles?
Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold. They waxed bold. Why were they waxing bold? Because they had the spirit of Christ inside of them.

And said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles. So Paul and Barnabas had a clear understanding of the word of God, a clear understanding of the prophecy of Zechariah 12:7, that said that the gospel would come to the southern kingdom, or the Jews, first. But since some of them rejected it, the religious leaders at the time, now the gospel is being brought to the Gentiles, which is the northern kingdom according to the Bible.

But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts. Paul and Barnabas got deported out of the land because of their own people.

note.label: Traitors and Their Exquisite Subtlety: The Judas Iscariot Effect

points: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe. And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch. They went right back. Just like the team in Kenya: when they stoned us, we went right back. We took those stones, brothers got hit in the jaw, and we came right back. We are not going anywhere.
It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul: men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus. The contention goes into that argument, that strife. Barnabas wanted to take Mark, which was his nephew. Barnabas saw something in Mark that Paul did not see. But they got into a very big argument, and it was so bad that they said, you go your way, I will do the work here and you go do the work there.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: This meant getting circumcised to reestablish the covenant with Abraham and giving an animal sacrifice to reestablish the covenant of Moses. Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them over this, so they were sent to the apostles and elders in Jerusalem.

note.label: Galatians 2: The Council at Jerusalem and Justification by Faith

points: James, Cephas, and John gave Paul and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision. The heathen: talking about the northern kingdom.

note.label: Acts 10 Reloaded: Call No Man Common

points: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation. The class looked up dissimulation: deception, hypocrisy, pretense, deceit; in other words, being fake.

note.label: Acts 10 Reloaded: Call No Man Common

points: He did not want to be seen eating with them. The other Jews also dissembled with him, and even Barnabas was carried away, withdrawing himself from the northern kingdom, not sitting or eating with them.

note.label: Galatians 2: The Council at Jerusalem and Justification by Faith
